label: Search description
text: 🤖 An application architecture extracted from five systems that kept rebuilding it. One person, one process, one database that sleeps into a bucket. Cost-efficient, Available, Replicated, Lightweight, Open, Secure.
context: The two-line summary search engines show under the title. Keep the 🤖 marker; it is the site's factor X rule.

label: Headline
text: Lower your costs. Own your software.

notes: The word 'Own' is coloured; keep a single verb to colour

label: Lede
text: Every person gets their own process and their own database. Idle apps sleep into a bucket and wake on the next request. The whole system is one static binary you can run yourself.
context: The paragraph under the headline. Three short sentences: the isolation, the sleeping, the ownership. It replaces the old lede which also said 'encrypted' and 'nothing that phones home'.
